osm.query_logic: amenity=place_of_worship + religion=muslim; building=mosque as supplementary signal, not sole proof of active worship
osm.production_note: Maintain ODbL compliance and provenance at database/export level.

wikidata.purpose: authority resolution, aliases, identifiers, dates, architects where sourced
wikidata.production_note: Retain statement references; independently verify high-impact claims.

archnet.production_note: Index metadata and links; mirror files only where item terms allow.

akdn_akaa.purpose: award project records, architects, project narratives, drawings/photos where exposed
akdn_akaa.production_note: Use as authoritative reference; store attribution and links.

unesco.purpose: heritage mosque/site records and conservation context
unesco.production_note: Use official heritage descriptions as source; media rights separately assessed.
